In private chats I’m interested in (1) how you’re approaching rankings/votes, and (2) who you see as high-risk or overly influential. I value players who think critically but aren’t rigid. Let’s avoid early chaos and focus on sustainable moves. Open to pairing with anyone who brings clarity and a plan—no empty promises.

Are you open to anchoring such a duo? I value your directness and want to ensure we’re building something durable, not just reactive.
